adjacent.text: Schwab's 2026 ADV disclosed that, since June 2026, the ETF compensation disclosure was revised to reflect updates to the compensation arrangement between CS&Co. and sponsors or issuers of certain third-party exchange-traded products for platform services.
adjacent.differs_because: The disclosed change concerns CS&Co.'s own compensation received from third-party ETF sponsors/issuers for platform services (firm revenue), not how Schwab's financial consultants or wealth advisors are compensated.
